articles.title_en: Zelensky has always been against Trump, peace in Ukraine — RDIF CEO
articles.lead_en: President US Donald Trump’s peace initiatives will succeed despite warmongering resistance, Russian president’s special envoy for investment and economic cooperation with foreign countries and CEO of the Russian Direct Investment Fund Kirill Dmitriev said
